title: Impact of DMEK on visual quality in patients with Fuchs’ endothelial dystrophy

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: Fuchs endothelial dystrophy without previous corneal surgery; 22 pseudophakic DMEK and 29 triple DMEK

groups.description: DMEK with surgeon-prepared grafts (Melles technique), SF6 20% tamponade, standardized postoperative steroids; prospective institutional case series

series.baseline_label: Preoperative ECD as tabulated (Table 2 'Preoperative'); the article does not state whether it is the recipient's or the donor's count
series.notes: mean ± SD (range) per caption; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Tab2 rows other than ECD (CDVA, CCT, keratometry, densitometry)

notes: Prospective case series of 51 patients (one DMEK eye each) operated February 2018 to February 2019.

Four patients needing secondary keratoplasty (3 repeat DMEK for persistent graft dysfunction, 1 PK for stromal scarring) were excluded from the postoperative analysis and 41 patients completed the 3-month visit (Results), so postoperative values are conditional on graft survival and follow-up.

Reference kind: Table 2 labels the value 'Preoperative' and Methods mention only specular microscopy (Oculus/Nidek CEM-530) without attributing it to the donor tissue; it is recorded as labelled (patient_preoperative). The attribution to recipient or donor endothelium is unverified.
ECD measured preoperatively and at 1 and 3 months after DMEK.
